Nitin Samuel Kujur vs State Of Jharkhand on 24 May, 2024 
Author: Sanjay Prasad
Bench: Sanjay Prasad
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 W.P.(S) No. 3014 of 2024
 ---------
Nitin Samuel Kujur ..... Petitioner Versus
1.State of Jharkhand, through its Chief Secretary
2.Department of Personnel Administrative and Rajbhasha, Government of Jharkhand
3.Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand through
Secretary
4.Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand through
Director
5.Jharkhand Public Service Commissioner through its Secretary
6.Controller of Examination, Jharkhand Public Service Commission, Circular Road, Ranchi .....
Respondents 
---------- 
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Prasad 
----------
For the Petitioner : Shubhashis Rasik Soren, Advocate For the State : Ms. Prity Priyamvada, A.C. to
G.P.-V For the J.P.S.C. : Mr. Sanjay Piprawall, Advocate
----------
02/24.05.2024 Heard Mr. Shubhashis Rasik Soren, learned counsel for the petitioner, Ms. Preeti Priyamvada, learned A.C. to G.P.-V and Mr. Sanjay Piprawall, learned counsel appearing on behalf of J.P.S.C.
2. The learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the J.P.S.C. appeared through Video Conferencing and there is no complaint with respect to Audio and Video quality. 
Nitin Samuel Kujur vs State Of Jharkhand on 24 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29785768/
1 3. This case has been notified today at 01.15 P.M. after consent of the Acting Chief Justice today,
received by the learned Joint Registrar (L & C) I/C.
4. This writ petition has been filed on behalf of the petitioner to shift the cut-off date from 01.08.2020 to 01.08.2023, as mentioned in clause (6) of Advertisement No.18 of 2023 (i.e.
Annexure-1) published by the Jharkhand Public Service Commission for filling up the vacancy of Food Safety Officers and for other ancillary reliefs. 
5. I.A. No. 5168 of 2024 has been filed on behalf of the petitioner to allowing him to fill up the form and to appear in the examination scheduled to be held on 27.05.2024 as per Annexure-7 by J.P.S.C.
and to participate in the examination. 
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner has raised a number of submissions and submitted that the advertisement in question (i.e. Annexure-1) has not been issued in consonance with Rule 7(x) of Jharkhand State Food Safety Services (Recruitment, Promotion & Other Conditions of Service)
Rules, 2015. It has been submitted that the vacancy of the year 2020 and the year 2023 have been clubbed together. 
It is submitted that though the petitioner had tried to fill up the form but he could not succeed as cut of off date was fixed as 01.08.2020 by the J.P.S.C. It is submitted that the petitoner, along with two others had filed representation before the Additional Chief Secretary, Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare, Government of Jharkhand on 26.06.2023, and hence, in the interest of justice,
he may be permitted to appear in the forthcoming examination scheduled to be held on 27.05.2024.
7. On the other hand, Mr. Sanjay Piprawall, learned counsel appearing for the J.P.S.C. submitted that the examination of Food Safety Officer is going to be held pursuant to order dated 16.05.2024 passed in WP(PIL) No.171 of 2012 by the Division Bench of this Court. 
It is further submitted that the petitioner had full opportunity to challenge the advertisement, i.e.
Annexure-1, including the cut-off date much earlier, instead of filing this writ petition at a very later stage.
It is submitted that all Examination Centres have been fixed and Admit Cards have already been issued.
It is submitted that no representation has been filed before the J.P.S.C. by the petitioner.
8. This Court finds that the petitioner has approached this Court after 10 months' delay, although the petitioner and two others filed representation on 26.06.2023 before the Additional Chief Secretary, Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare, Government of Jharkhand, but the condition of shifting the Cut-Off date of the advertisement was not challenged earlier.
9. It appears that only after notifying the examination date, which is fixed on 27.05.2024, as per Press Release vide Annexure-7, the present writ petition has been filed before the Court on Nitin Samuel Kujur vs State Of Jharkhand on 24 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29785768/
2 15.05.2024 by the petitioner. 
10. Even this case has been notified today, i.e. 24.05.2024, at 01.15 P.M. after approval of the Acting Chief Justice today, received by the Joint Registrar (L & C) I/C.
11. However, this Court, after going through the details of the case, finds that the petitioner has moved this Court at a very belated staged after the date of examination has been fixed on 27.05.2024 and therefore, it will not be proper for this Court to allow I.A. No. 5168 of 2024 at this stage. 
12. Hence, I.A. No. 5168 of 2024 is rejected at this stage. 
13. However, considering the fact that the petitioner had assailed the Advertisement No. 18 of 2023 (i.e. Annexure-1) on the ground of not following the Rule 7(x) of Jharkhand State Food Safety Services (Recruitment, Promotion & Other Conditions of Service) Rules, 2015, learned counsel for the State and learned Counsel for the J.P.S.C. are directed to file the counter affidavit, after the Summer Vacation. 
14. Put up this case on 11th June, 2024 before the appropriate Bench as the Roster.
(Sanjay Prasad, J.) Sachin/s.m.
